slide1.headline: EU AI Regulation Risks Undermining Europe's Security
slide1.subtitle: Recent reports highlight the potential risks of EU AI regulation

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: On 25 Mar 2026, the International Business Times UK reported that EU AI regulation risks undermining Europe's security and economic growth.
The report highlights the potential risks of overregulation in the AI sector.
90% of organisations are pressured to loosen identity controls for AI, according to a Delinea report.
This could have significant implications for the future of AI development in Europe.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The EU AI regulation could have far-reaching consequences for the development of AI in Europe.
It could impact the ability of companies to innovate and compete in the global AI market.
The regulation could also have implications for national security and economic growth.
Questions to consider: What are the potential risks and benefits of EU AI regulation? How might it impact the development of AI in Europe?

Google also unveiled new AI security tools, highlighting the growing importance of AI in security.
The acquisition and product launch demonstrate Google's commitment to improving its security offerings.
The new AI security tools will help to protect against cyber threats and improve cloud security.
